_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. Found look pieces (spec section 13). buried: loose colours and glow tints; after_hexes = the planet-wide count of clean hexes at which the simulator hands the piece over (the game would roll a chance per hex with this expected schedule; a flat 'one per 40 hexes' would give about 125 pieces over the six cities, not the 8 the spec asks for). wreck: a robot wreck off the path in `district`; it can be reached once that district is at_clean_share clean and costs explore_s of Lumi's time. source: handed over when that district's source is shut. set: the pieces that complete the planet's one design; the last comes from the last district's source so the set completes at the ending. Piece ids are working names.
